newsitem.title: USA: McDonald & Co seeking ability to make stock split.
newsitem.headline: McDonald & Co seeking ability to make stock split.

text.p: McDonald & Co Investments Inc plans to ask shareholders for permission to expand its authorized common shares from 15 million to 50 million at its annual meeting later this month to give McDonald the option of a stock split in the future, spokesman Bill Chambers said Monday.
"Right now it would be difficult to split the stock with the current amount of authorized shares," Chambers said. "The increased number gives the board the option to split it."
The request has been included in the proxy statement for the annual meeting July 30, Chambers said.
It sets no specific timing for a stock split and while the brokerage firm has authorization for 15 million common shares right now, it has about nine million outstanding, Chambers added.

The statement also includes language that notes the expansion could have an anti-takeover effect, but Chambers said Monday its inclusion satisfied U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission requirements. "In terms of any anti-takeover language that was included in the proxy, that language was there as a requirement by the SEC," Chambers said.
Takeover talk among regional investment banks has risen in recent months with Banker's Trust New York Corp's proposed acquisition of Alex. Brown Inc, among other major deals.
